Actually the rule for document-noise says best_value from register, but here it's classified as same-entity due to spelling drift. The best value should be the register's canonical, correctly spelled form.

Note the page text also contains "Number R129/2000-NL1-16.07" vs register "R129/2000-NL1-2016.07" but that conflict isn't asked — only the applicant axis.
